english.note: Use this for an event or period that lasts only a short time, rather than for concise wording.

exampleSentences.english: This power outage was only brief.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 ci3 ting4 din6 zi2 hai6 dyun2 zaam6 ge3

english.note: Use this when stressing that something lasts only a short time, rather than merely saying that it is not permanent.

exampleSentences.english: This kind of happiness is impermanent.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ne1 zung2 faai3 lok6 hou2 dyun2 zaam6

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that lasts only briefly.

exampleSentences.english: This momentary calm disappeared in an instant.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢種短暫嘅平靜，轉眼就冇咗。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 zung2 dyun2 zaam6 ge3 ping4 zing6 zyun2 ngaan5 zau6 mou5 zo2

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that lasts only a short time, such as a pleasure or feeling.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 fan6 hoi1 sam1 hou2 dyun2 zaam6

english.note: Use 短暫 for something that lasts only a short time or is momentary.

exampleSentences.english: This calm lasted only an instant.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 fan6 ping4 zing6 zi2 hai6 dyun2 zaam6 ge3
